subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale event, offering up to 50% off on select items! Don't miss this opportunity to upgrade your wardrobe with the latest summer trends at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online to take advantage of these amazing deals before they're gone. Hurry, as this sale is only valid for a limited time. Happy shopping!
